sections.label: Effect
sections.text: A gnoll acting this turn drops an iron-jawed snare into the area. The first time any enemy moves into the area, they make an **Agility test**. If they were unaware of the snare, the test takes a bane.

sections.label: Effect
sections.text: While an enemy is [bleeding](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/bleeding) this way, each gnoll in the encounter gains an edge on strikes made against them.

features.body: One gnoll [minion](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.organization/minion) suddenly explodes into a pool of blood, splattering the area within 3 squares of them. Any gnoll who starts their turn in this area deals an extra 5 damage on their next strike before the end of their turn. Once per round, an abyssal hyena who starts their turn in the area turns into a **gnoll marauder**, keeping their current [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina).
features.name: Bloodpool

features.body: Until the end of the encounter, the encounter map is encased in a soundscape of laughter and howling. Each enemy takes a bane on the first power roll they make each round. Whenever a gnoll is killed, this effect is suppressed until the start of the next round.
features.name: Echoes of Laughter

flavor: At the start of any gnoll's turn, you can spend Malice to activate one of the following features.
name: Gnoll Malice
